candidates.source_name: Slov-Lex — e-Zbierka (Zbierka zákonov SR), consolidated legal texts
candidates.why_relevant: Official, legally binding electronic Collection of Laws of the Slovak Republic. Every banking/payments statute, its amendments and its effective dates (účinnosť) are legally required to appear here, with time-versioned consolidated texts (e.g. Act 483/2001 Z. z. on Banks, Act 492/2009 Z. z. on Payment Services). It is the authoritative anchor for any deadline or in-force date in SK.
candidates.source_subtype: official law gazette / consolidated legislation database
candidates.access_status: public, free, no login for reading; JavaScript-heavy front end
candidates.legal_status: official state publication; texts are public-domain legal acts
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Prefer the static mirror (static.slov-lex.sk) which serves plain HTML/PDF per act and per version date — e.g. /static/SK/ZZ/2001/483/<YYYYMMDD>.html and /static/SK/ZZ/<year>/<num>/vyhlasene_znenie.html. Poll the year index for new Z. z. numbers; parse the 'Účinnosť'/'Vyhlásené' fields. Avoid scraping the JS portlet UI.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from search results
queries_used: Slov-Lex zákon o bankách 483/2001 novela účinnosť
e-Zbierka zákonov nový portál Slov-Lex vyhlásené znenie čiastka 2025

candidates.source_name: Slov-Lex — static PDF/HTML mirror of the Collection of Laws (static.slov-lex.sk)
candidates.why_relevant: Machine-friendly delivery layer for the same official texts: per-act PDFs of the promulgated issue (čiastka) and per-date HTML consolidations. This is the practical ingestion endpoint for an automated pipeline, sidestepping the JS portal.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Deterministic URL templating by year/number: /pdf/SK/ZZ/<year>/<num>/ZZ_<year>_<num>.pdf and /static/SK/ZZ/<year>/<num>/vyhlasene_znenie.html; crawl politely, cache by ELI-like key year+number+version-date.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from Slov-Lex search results (URL pattern observed repeatedly)
queries_used: e-Zbierka zákonov nový portál Slov-Lex vyhlásené znenie čiastka 2025

candidates.source_name: Slov-Lex — eLegislatíva: legislative process tracker (LP/YYYY/NNN)
candidates.why_relevant: The single most valuable upstream/early-warning source in this cell: every ministerial draft bill and decree passes through a numbered legislative process (LP/2025/xxx) carrying the draft text, dôvodová správa (explanatory memorandum), doložka vplyvov (impact assessment), tabuľka zhody (EU transposition correlation table) and the submitting department. Reveals what will bind banks/PSPs 6–18 months before it is in force, plus the responsible officials and bodies.
candidates.access_status: public; portal is JavaScript-rendered which complicates naive scraping
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate LP ids per year at /elegislativa/legislativne-procesy/SK/LP/<year>/<n>; render with a headless browser or capture the underlying XHR/JSON endpoints; filter by submitting body (Ministerstvo financií SR, NBS) and by title keywords (banky, platobné služby, spotrebiteľský úver, finančný trh, AML).
candidates.discovered_via_method: targeted sk-language query on legislative process numbering
queries_used: Slov-Lex "legislatívny proces" LP/2025 medzirezortné pripomienkové konanie ministerstvo financií

candidates.source_name: Slov-Lex — Medzirezortné pripomienkové konanie (inter-ministerial comment procedure) / Pripomienky
candidates.why_relevant: The formal public consultation stage (MPK) with a hard comment deadline. Comments are published with their author — so this exposes which banks, the Slovenská banková asociácia, card schemes, fintechs, NBS and other ministries objected to what, and how the submitter responded (vyhodnotenie pripomienok). Directly serves the 'consultations' and 'deadlines' topics and doubles as an actor map.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: For each relevant LP id fetch /pripomienky/legislativne-procesy/SK/LP/<year>/<n>/pripomienky/zobraz (paginate via ?page=N); extract commenter organisation, provision commented on, 'zásadná'/'obyčajná' flag and resolution status.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from the eLegislatíva process pages
queries_used: Slov-Lex "legislatívny proces" LP/2025 medzirezortné pripomienkové konanie ministerstvo financií

candidates.source_name: Slov-Lex — Predbežná informácia (pre-legislative early notice, PI/YYYY/NNN)
candidates.why_relevant: Earliest formal signal available: ministries must publish a 'preliminary information' announcing intent to legislate, its goals and expected timetable, before any draft text exists. For a market-intelligence pipeline this is the true leading indicator for SK banking/payments rules.
candidates.access_status: public; sortable list view with query params
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the list sorted by creation date (orderByCol=datumZaciatkuMPKAleboVytvoreniaProcesu&orderByType=desc) weekly; filter by predkladateľ = MF SR / NBS and by banking-payments keywords; link each PI to the later LP id.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk-language query for the statutory pre-notice instrument
queries_used: Slov-Lex "predbežná informácia" PI/2025 zákon o platobných službách

candidates.source_name: NR SR — Parlamentné tlače (parliamentary prints) index
candidates.why_relevant: Canonical repository of every bill text (návrh zákona), explanatory memorandum, committee reports (spoločná správa výborov) and amendments as tabled in the National Council. Required reading to know the final wording and the transitional/effective-date provisions actually voted on.

candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the CPT list per parliamentary term/session; documents resolve to /web/Dynamic/DocumentPreview.aspx?DocID=<n> (HTML/RTF). Watch out for ASP.NET viewstate on search forms — prefer direct list URLs and DocID enumeration keyed off the bill detail page.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball

candidates.source_name: NR SR — Návrhy zákonov predložené NR SR / bill detail tracker
candidates.why_relevant: Live state machine for each bill: submitter, reading stage, committee assignment, dates, votes and outcome. The per-bill detail page (sid=zakony/zakon&MasterID=<id>) is the natural join key between the Slov-Lex LP process and the final Z. z. number.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the 'predložené' list weekly; for hits, fetch Default.aspx?sid=zakony/zakon&MasterID=<id> and diff the stage table; also track the fast-track list (sid=zakony/prehlad/slk, skrátené legislatívne konanie) which is where surprise banking measures appear with near-zero notice.

negative_findings.description: Searched specifically for an official Slov-Lex open API, ELI-based identifiers or a SPARQL endpoint for the Zbierka zákonov. No official, documented public API surfaced. What surfaced instead were a national standardisation study (MIRRI), a community scraper, and a commercial REST product (LexAPI/LexDATA).
negative_findings.result_summary: No confirmed official machine-readable API for Slov-Lex; ingestion will likely rely on the static.slov-lex.sk file mirror plus headless rendering of the eLegislatíva portal, or a commercial feed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Determines the engineering cost and fragility of the whole SK legislative-monitoring pipeline, and whether a paid feed is justified.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Slovak for open-data exports of NR SR parliamentary prints and voting records. The NR SR site exposes only HTML search/result pages; no official bulk export or documented API was found. The only structured route observed is the third-party Slovensko.Digital ecosystem.
negative_findings.result_summary: NR SR appears to offer no first-party open-data export for bills and votes; scraping the legacy ASP.NET pages is currently the default.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The parliament stage is where final wording and effective dates are set; a fragile scraper here is a single point of failure for deadline tracking.

negative_findings.description: Searches in Slovak for 'Plán legislatívnych úloh vlády 2026' returned a large share of CZECH results (Ministerstvo financí ČR, vlada.gov.cz) because of the close similarity of Czech and Slovak legal vocabulary.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slovak-language queries about legislative planning are noisy with Czech-Republic sources; SK-specific results required the terms 'Slovenskej republiky' / 'SR' / site scoping.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any automated SK query layer must pin the country explicitly (site:*.gov.sk, 'Slovenskej republiky', 'Z. z.') or it will silently ingest Czech law as Slovak.

negative_findings.description: Multiple Slov-Lex legislative-process and comment URLs were reported by search as requiring JavaScript to display content. Not confirmed by a direct fetch in this pass — treated as a hypothesis, not a verdict, and certainly not as evidence the pages are dead.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slov-Lex eLegislatíva and pripomienky views are probably client-rendered; a plain HTTP fetch may return an empty shell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Drives the choice of collection method (headless browser or captured XHR endpoints) for the highest-value pointer source in this cell.

negative_findings.description: Attempted to locate a specific 'Predbežná informácia' (PI/2025/...) concerning the Payment Services Act 492/2009 Z. z. The PI register itself was found, but no matching payments-specific PI entry surfaced through search.
negative_findings.result_summary: PI register located and catalogued; the specific payments-related PI was not confirmed to exist.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Absence in search is not absence in the register — the PI list must be enumerated directly rather than probed by keyword through a general search engine.

negative_findings.description: No URL in this slice was fetched and confirmed reachable by me; all were observed as search results. Several (rokovania.gov.sk/RVL/Material, nrsr.sk/dl/, lexapi.sk) are recorded on a single search-result sighting.

coverage_gaps.description: No SK constitutional/judicial layer was covered: Ústavný súd SR (constitutional challenges that can suspend or annul a financial-sector provision, e.g. bank levy litigation) and NS/NSS SR case-law databases.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a follow-up sweep for 'Ústavný súd SR nálezy odvod bánk', ustavnysud.sk decision search, and the Slov-Lex judicial-decisions section; classify as direct sources for regulatory-risk monitoring.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language coverage of the SK legislative machinery is thin by nature: Slov-Lex, NR SR, LRV and rokovania.gov.sk publish essentially only in Slovak. The only substantive EN entry points found were the NBS English legislation pages and N-Lex.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Accept SK as the working language for this cell and budget for machine translation; treat NBS EN pages as the sole quasi-official English rendering and never as the legal text of record.

coverage_gaps.description: Industry-side actors that appear inside the MPK comment files were not separately scouted: Slovenská banková asociácia (SBA), Asociácia poskytovateľov platobných služieb / fintech bodies, and Republiková únia zamestnávateľov, all of which publish their own positions on banking and payments drafts.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated sweep on sbaonline.sk and comparable association sites, and mine commenter names from a sample of Slov-Lex pripomienky files to build the SK actor map empirically rather than by assumption.

coverage_gaps.description: No confirmed identifier that joins a Slov-Lex LP/PI process to an NR SR parliamentary print (CPT/MasterID) to the final Z. z. number. Each system uses its own key.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Design and test a join heuristic (title normalisation + submitter + date window), and validate it against a known chain such as the 2025/2026 banking act amendment; record the mapping as a first-class dataset.

coverage_gaps.description: Regional/EU upstream layer was out of scope for this cell but is the origin of most SK banking rules: EUR-Lex transposition deadlines and EBA/ECB acts drive the tabuľka zhody attached to SK drafts.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Ensure another coverage cell owns EUR-Lex national-transposition-measures (NIM) tracking for SK, and link it to this cell's LP ids via the correlation tables.

coverage_gaps.description: Terms of service / robots.txt for slov-lex.sk, nrsr.sk, rokovania.sk and the commercial mirrors were not examined in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Before building any crawler, fetch robots.txt and ToS for each domain and record a per-source crawl policy (rate, user-agent, permitted paths).

brief: Slovakia's legislative machinery is unusually well-instrumented for source scouting: a single state portal, Slov-Lex, carries the whole chain from pre-legislative notice (predbežná informácia) through numbered draft-law processes (LP/YYYY/NNN) with explanatory memoranda, impact assessments and EU correlation tables, through the public inter-ministerial comment procedure (MPK) with named commenters, and ends in the legally binding e-Zbierka zákonov where every banking and payments rule and its účinnosť date must appear. Between those poles sit two mandatory gates worth tracking independently — the Legislatívna rada vlády SR (lrv.rokovania.sk) and the Cabinet (rokovania.gov.sk) — and then NR SR, whose parlamentné tlače, bill tracker and Finance and Budget Committee records reveal late-stage amendments and the fast-track procedure that can compress notice to days. The material constraints are practical rather than legal: everything is Slovak-only, no official machine-readable API for Slov-Lex or NR SR surfaced, the highest-value process pages appear to be JavaScript-rendered, and the three systems share no common identifier, so a join heuristic between LP id, parliamentary print and Z. z. number is the key engineering prerequisite. Commercial and civic mirrors (LexAPI/LexDATA, zakonypreludi.sk, Slovensko.Digital) exist as fallbacks and change detectors but must never displace Slov-Lex as the citation of record.
